NameMultiLanguage.zh: 危机合约-武林寺庙第一部分-紧急-day15

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All zombies gain +70% movement speed, and all special zombies gain +40% health and attack damage
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有僵尸的移动速度+70%，所有特殊僵尸的生命值和攻击力+40%

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Qigong Zombies have -30% movement speed but gain increased qigong release speed
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有气功僵尸的移动速度-30%，但释放气功的速度提升

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Drinking are more likely to drink, receive significantly reduced damage while drinking, and gain increased attack damage, movement speed and damage reduction when intoxicated
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有醉酒僵尸更容易喝酒，喝酒时受到的伤害超大幅降低，醉酒状态下攻击力，移动速度和减伤增加

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Gong gain +80% health. Some Gong are equipped with level 3 armor and can only summon other Gong; some Gong have increased summon quantity and reduced summon time
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有铜锣僵尸的生命值+80%，部分铜锣僵尸携带三级防具，会且仅会召唤其他铜锣僵尸；部分铜锣僵尸的召唤数量和时间提升
部分波次和动态出怪有所不同
